verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents a rate-limits page, and authenticated API responses expose limit headers when a per-minute limit applies, so a user can learn their request limit at runtime. Nothing in the pack ties those limits to pricing tiers, documents concurrent-session caps, or says how to raise the cap or what that costs. missing for 10: per-tier concurrency/request limit values, concurrent-session caps, cost or upgrade path to raise the cap, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I know the maximum concurrent sessions or requests allowed on my pricing tier and the cost to raise that cap

citations.quote: Authenticated API responses expose these headers when a per-minute limit applies
